localTarball.name: neo.mjs
localTarball.scope: The unpacked pre-release source archive was rebuilt offline with existing local dependencies. Its source version was 13.4.0. Verification of a published v14 package remains a cut-day step.

postMerge.scope: Production Portal built and served locally from the actual merged Engine commit, all eleven changed covers read directly from the public host. The released site walkthrough follows the v14 package rollout.
